name: LED Headlight Conversion Kit
description: Plug-and-play LED kit with 6000K crisp white output, built-in CANbus and an IP68 housing. Fitting available in-store.

name: 4K Dash Cam — Front & Rear
description: 4K front and 1080p rear recording with parking mode, GPS logging and a hardwire kit. Professional installation included.

name: Custom Leather Seat Covers
description: Tailor-made full leather seat covers with contrast stitching, cut for your exact make and model. Choice of colours.

name: 19" Alloy Wheels (Set of 4)
description: Flow-forged 19-inch alloys in gloss black or hyper silver. Sold with tyres fitted and balanced, staggered options available.

name: 10" Android Head Unit
description: Android 13 unit with wireless CarPlay/Android Auto, GPS, Bluetooth and steering-wheel control retention. Model-specific bezels.

name: All-Weather Floor Mats
description: Laser-measured rubber floor liners with raised edges. Mud, rain and dust don't stand a chance. Exact-fit per model.

name: Performance Cat-Back Exhaust
description: Stainless cat-back system with adjustable valved muffler. Deeper tone without drone. Fitting and alignment quoted separately.

name: Cold Air Intake & Filter
description: Washable high-flow cone filter with heat shield. Better throttle response and induction sound, no remap needed.

name: Iridium Spark Plugs (Set of 4)
description: Genuine NGK iridium plugs for smoother idle and better economy. We stock the correct heat range for your engine — bring your chassis number.

name: Ceramic Brake Pads — Front Axle
description: Low-dust ceramic pads with anti-noise shims. Fitting with brake clean and caliper service available at the workshop.

name: Magnetic Vent Phone Mount
description: N52-magnet vent mount with a low-profile head. Holds any phone through rough roads. One-hand snap on and off.

name: 10" Subwoofer + Enclosure
description: Powered slim sub in a sealed enclosure that fits behind most boots. Clean bass without sacrificing cargo space.
